result.topic_en: Corollary on comparing the sounds of elastic rods of different length and thickness (pitch proportional to diameter over length squared for cylindrical rods), followed by a scholium extending the formulas to rods with rectangular cross-sections.

items.english: For if the diameter of the thickness of such rods is c and the length a, then under similar circumstances the sounds will be as c/a^2.

items.english: But our formulas can also be applied to rods whose thickness is given by any other figure. To show this, let us consider a rod whose cross-sections perpendicular to the length are rectangles ABCD.
